notes:
### New
- **Convert audio files.** Select tracks and choose **Convert to AIFF** (the
  default format is set in Settings → Convert): it just runs, with progress
  and Cancel in the status bar. The Convert tab scans your whole library or
  chosen playlists, lists every file that can be converted, and converts
  them. Supported: FLAC, WAV, AIFF, Apple Lossless, AAC and MP3, with tags
  and artwork kept. The converter is built in. OpenCrate never upconverts: a
  lossy file can't become lossless or get a higher bit rate, and lossless
  files keep their bit depth. Originals are never changed or deleted.
- **Convert new songs automatically.** A new setting in Settings → Convert
  converts songs to your default format as you add them to OpenCrate (drag
  FLAC files into a playlist, say); they are then analysed as usual.
- **Switch to the converted file.** After converting, OpenCrate points the
  tracks in OpenCrate, Rekordbox and Engine DJ at the new files (cues,
  loops, grids, ratings and playlists are kept; each library is backed up
  first) and can undo it. Cue positions on converted MP3s haven't been
  checked on real players yet.

### Changed
- The installer is bigger (about 11 MB) because it now contains the audio
  converter.
